verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents a REST API that can perform all web-client operations, authorized via OAuth 2.0. Its web features include applying credit notes to invoices and creating recurring invoices, so an agent could apply credits and manage recurring billing programmatically. However, the evidence shows no subscription or plan objects to create or change, and OAuth scopes are never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: native subscription creation and plan-change endpoints, documented scoped OAuth permissions for agent access, an OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of agent operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions

citations.quote: The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
Zoho REST APIs uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate calls.
Create a credit note and apply it to an invoice.
Create recurring invoices for transactions that occur at regular intervals
